description: This source file implements JSON file handling functions, including reading JSON content from files, parsing JSON data, extracting array nodes, and saving array contents to files. It also contains a main function for processing JSON files and saving specific data structures based on JSON content.

methods.name: fsize
methods.description: Returns the size of a file in bytes.

methods.name: isNodeArrayType
methods.description: Checks if a cJSON node is of array type.

methods.name: readFromFile
methods.description: Reads the entire content of a file into a buffer.

methods.name: getArrayNode
methods.description: Recursively searches for and returns the first array node within a JSON structure.

methods.name: saveToFile
methods.description: Saves elements of a JSON array node to a file, each element on a new line.

methods.name: saveIfNodeContainsLists
methods.description: Checks if a JSON node contains an array list and saves it to a file if so.

methods.name: iterateAndSaveArrayNodes
methods.description: Parses JSON data and saves all array nodes found within the 'features' list.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the file path format string based on environment variables or defaults.
